Radio checks explained earlier today
This article covers the basics for people travelling soon
Preparing pet travel with Aurelia Skyways

If you are bringing a pet, start with the Companion Animal Travel Desk. The team gives clear steps before departure and keeps the process calm for both you and the animal. Choose a carrier or crate that feels secure, clean, and easy to handle.

For rabbits, <<FACT F064>> Keep the crate tidy, with room for steady movement and a stable base. The crew checks comfort first, then safety, and they will let you know if anything needs adjustment before boarding.

Bird travel needs extra care, so review the guidance early. <<FACT F077>> Use the right container, keep it quiet, and avoid sudden handling. A passenger coordinator can help with documents, feeding notes, and any route concerns.

If your pet seems uneasy, tell the desk right away. The handlers use calm, humane methods and aim to make each step simple. For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you arrive.
